items.question: In change management for a large government financial system rollout, how should we tailor our response depending on whether stakeholders are unaware, lack capability, or are actively resistant?
items.answerSketch: The material distinguishes three resistance categories: unknowing stakeholders need communications to build awareness of what they must do; unable stakeholders need training and workplace support to build skills and knowledge; unwilling stakeholders require communications, sanctions, negotiation, persuasion and confrontation on specific issues.

items.question: What do the data say about physical inactivity in Indonesia — the share of adults not getting enough exercise and how Indonesians' daily step counts compare internationally?
items.answerSketch: About 43.5% of Indonesian adults are insufficiently physically active (SDKI 2023), and Indonesians average roughly 3,500 steps per day — the lowest among all countries studied by Althoff et al. (2017). This sedentary pattern is linked to obesity, cardiovascular disease, and mental health problems.

items.question: In AMANA's internal career levelling framework, how do the expectations differ between someone with 4-6 years of experience and someone at the 6-10 year band?
items.answerSketch: Mid-career staff (4-6 years) are expected to apply critical evaluation — judging the quality and efficiency of work, not just executing it, in lead/coordinator roles — while the 6-10 year managerial band shifts from doing to supervising, requiring project management, people coordination and cross-functional coordination.

items.question: What prior Ministry of Health–validated digital health work does AMANA cite to justify its credibility for an AI-in-health initiative, and what complementary role does its foundation partner play?

items.question: What institutional and capacity weaknesses commonly hold back regional revenue agencies in managing local taxes, and what are their consequences?
items.answerSketch: Issues include outdated/inaccurate property tax data (ownership changes, fictitious objects, NJOP below market), fragmented coordination between the revenue agency and the regional finance body causing inaccurate financial reports, absent or unfollowed documented collection SOPs leaving processes dependent on individuals, and no unit owning the transformation agenda so reform only happens under external pressure such as audits or the head of region.

items.question: Why does stakeholder mapping matter in public sector reform, and what makes resistance from mid-level officials especially dangerous?
items.answerSketch: Stakeholders have differing interests and incentives — apparent resistance often signals unaddressed interests in the policy design; a single unengaged high-authority official can halt a process while the right champion accelerates it; positions shift over time so maps need periodic updating; and a blueprint must explicitly show how critical stakeholder interests are addressed. The deadliest resistance comes not from the bottom but from middle management who feel threatened.

items.question: Dalam penawaran platform analitik enterprise untuk perusahaan multifinance, berapa rata-rata tingkat pengembalian investasi yang diklaim vendor dan dalam jangka waktu berapa lama?

items.question: Apa perbedaan asumsi tentang perilaku pemerintah daerah antara teori federalisme fiskal klasik (Tiebout, Musgrave, Oates) dengan pendekatan generasi kedua dan public choice dalam kerangka penyusunan Theory of Change?
items.answerSketch: Teori klasik fokus pada pembagian tugas belanja dan kewenangan pendapatan antar level pemerintahan (penugasan belanja dulu, baru pembiayaan), sementara generasi kedua/public choice tidak mengasumsikan pemerintah benevolen melainkan aktor strategis berkepentingan sendiri, sehingga aturan fiskal membentuk insentif yang memengaruhi pola belanja dan perilaku daerah.

items.question: In the SPAN rollout, how did stakeholder engagement differ between senior management and accounts payable staff across the project phases?
items.answerSketch: Senior management (high influence/interest/impact) were engaged via kick-off meetings, budget and resource approval, monthly progress reports, involvement in key decisions, bi-weekly status reviews and post-implementation performance reviews; AP staff (medium influence, high interest/impact) got awareness sessions, sandbox/UAT participation, in-depth training on invoice processing and system use, extra support during early use, regular feedback check-ins and tracking of processing times and error rates.

items.question: What service availability and user satisfaction targets are set for the health workforce digital platform under the Ministry of Health's 2025-2029 roadmap, and which units are accountable for them?
items.answerSketch: Targets include maintaining 99.9% SLA compliance annually, an average customer satisfaction score of 85% each quarter, and keeping accesses flagged as threats at no more than 25%, with threat-detection features in place; responsibility sits with Pusdatin/TTO and the data unit of the health workforce directorate general.

items.question: Why does Indonesia's copyright registration process at DJKI fail to screen out AI-generated material that lacks human authorship?
items.answerSketch: Because registration is declarative: the POP HC system issues certificates after only a formalities check and fee payment, without assessing human contribution, originality, protectability or similarity to existing works — so a certificate does not confer protection on otherwise unprotectable material, even though Law No. 28/2014 requires a human origin.

items.question: What are the recurring data quality problems in the regional financial information system used by the Ministry of Finance, and why do fixes only work downstream?
items.answerSketch: Submitted softcopy regional financial reports sometimes don't match the official local government documents (figures, account details, document versions); audit trails are incomplete and non-standard so changes can't be traced by DJPK; and validation rules differ across the various applications local governments use. The root cause is the absence of a nationally consistent master reference foundation, so improvements are only corrective at the downstream end and depend on manual reconciliation — reflecting a system oriented toward collecting reports rather than managing data as a strategic asset.

items.question: Dalam analisis pemangku kepentingan untuk program transformasi, bagaimana cara memverifikasi sikap sebenarnya seorang aktor kunci dan mengapa pengaruh informal bisa lebih menentukan daripada jabatan formal?
items.answerSketch: Sikap harus diverifikasi lewat wawancara informal, analisis pernyataan publik, dan observasi perilaku di forum koordinasi, karena ucapan di rapat formal sering berbeda dengan tindakan. Pengaruh mencakup kekuatan formal (jabatan, otoritas tanda tangan), informal (jaringan, akses ke pengambil keputusan), dan veto; staf teknis tanpa jabatan tinggi bisa sangat berpengaruh.

items.question: Apa saja indikator keberhasilan pembentukan kelompok kerja teknis lintas sektor untuk digitalisasi SDM kesehatan, dan bagaimana kelompok itu diresmikan oleh Ditjen SDMK?
items.answerSketch: Indikatornya adalah adanya dokumen resmi berisi peran, fungsi, area keterlibatan, dan agenda pertemuan TWG yang disahkan Ditjen SDMK, mencakup rencana kegiatan kolaboratif lintas sektor serta peta kebutuhan dan sumber daya untuk mendukung perjalanan nakes dari pendidikan hingga pasar kerja; peresmian dilakukan lewat Surat Penunjukan Langsung yang memuat tugas, wewenang, dan target koordinasi kolaborasi A-B-C-G-M.

items.question: How is the national ID number used in school enrolment systems in Indonesia to prevent duplicate student records, and which agencies are involved?
items.answerSketch: Student enrolment through the education ministry's data platforms uses NIK-based verification (with Dukcapil, Kemendikbudristek's Ditjen PAUD/Dikdas/Dikmen) to confirm student identity, cut duplication and ensure correct record linkage; NIK is mandatory for official school records across districts.

items.question: In Indonesia's AI policy dialogues, why is ethical AI framed as a governance issue rather than a purely technical one, and what role does public digital literacy play?
items.answerSketch: Ethical AI is presented as a governance challenge needing multi-stakeholder alignment, not just technical fixes; a digitally and cybersecurity-literate society adapts better to AI and protects its own data, while aligning AI use with regulation safeguards citizens' digital rights against misinformation and disinformation.

items.question: Apa dampak dihapuskannya kewajiban alokasi minimum anggaran kesehatan 5% APBN setelah terbitnya UU Kesehatan 2023 terhadap pendanaan program kesehatan digital?
items.answerSketch: UU No. 17/2023 mencabut mandatory health spending 5% APBN yang diatur UU No. 36/2009, sehingga alokasi kini ditentukan lewat penganggaran berbasis kinerja; kesehatan digital sebagai sub-sektor baru harus bersaing dengan justifikasi investasi yang kuat di tengah tren efisiensi anggaran.

items.question: Mengapa pengembangan kamera pengawas di Jakarta perlu diposisikan sebagai infrastruktur strategis Smart City, bukan hanya penambahan perangkat?
items.answerSketch: Karena arah RPJMD 2025–2029 menekankan pemerintahan berbasis data dan integrasi sistem informasi; CCTV mendukung pemantauan real-time, deteksi dini, dan keputusan berbasis bukti, sementara kondisi eksisting masih terfragmentasi (sistem dan dashboard berbeda antar perangkat daerah), sehingga perlu kerangka tata kelola terpadu lewat Grand Design.

items.question: Untuk risiko dengan probabilitas tinggi sekaligus dampak tinggi dalam matriks risiko transformasi, langkah mitigasi apa yang harus dimasukkan ke dalam blueprint?
items.answerSketch: Mitigasi proaktif wajib masuk blueprint: tetapkan PIC, timeline, dan indikator keberhasilan mitigasi, serta direview di setiap milestone.

items.question: For the health workforce component of Indonesia's national health data platform, what open governance question remains about how its technical working group should be structured?
items.answerSketch: It must still be decided whether it becomes a standalone technical working group dedicated to health workforce (SDMK) issues, or whether the existing SATUSEHAT technical working group simply takes on an expanded mandate covering health workforce matters.

items.question: What evidence links fragmented health information systems across Indonesian facilities to preventable maternal deaths?
items.answerSketch: Maternal death audit committees found referral cases involved out-of-sync information from multiple facilities, preventing reconstruction of clinical history; a study of 30 maternal deaths at an East Java referral hospital found delays traceable to incomplete clinical information at the point of care contributed directly to preventable deaths (e.g., undetected preeclampsia when antenatal records don't follow the patient).

items.question: How does Indonesia's per capita health spending compare with peer countries like Malaysia and Thailand, and how much more would be needed to reach the upper-middle-income average?
items.answerSketch: In 2020 Indonesia spent about $228 PPP per capita on health, roughly half that of similarly developed countries such as Malaysia and Thailand; reaching the upper-middle-income country average would require an additional $471 PPP per capita.

items.question: What is the estimated annual economic value Indonesia could save by shifting from physical ID cards to digital population identity, and what are the two categories that make up that figure?
items.answerSketch: Roughly USD 1.8–1.85 billion per year, split between direct savings to the state budget (APBN) from reduced physical materials and indirect savings from efficiency gains, less paperwork, and digital data access for institutions.

items.question: What service level and user satisfaction targets are set for the health workforce digital platform under the Ministry of Health's 2025-2029 roadmap, and which units are accountable for them?
items.answerSketch: Targets include maintaining 99.9% SLA compliance annually, an average customer satisfaction score of 85% each quarter, and keeping accesses flagged as threats at no more than 25%; the responsible parties are Pusdatin/TTO and the data unit of the Directorate General of Health Human Resources.

items.question: Metode analitis apa saja yang dipakai dalam kajian penyusunan Grand Design CCTV Jakarta untuk menilai kondisi regulasi dan tata kelola yang ada saat ini?
items.answerSketch: Kajian memakai pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif dengan tiga langkah: analisis isi untuk menarik prinsip kunci dari regulasi/pedoman internasional (legalitas, proporsionalitas, batas retensi data, keamanan informasi, akuntabilitas pengelola data), analisis kesenjangan membandingkan kondisi eksisting dengan standar dan praktik kota lain, serta analisis komparatif antar-kota melalui studi kasus.

items.question: What is the main weakness of Indonesia's existing AI governance frameworks, such as the national AI strategy and the financial regulator's ethics code, in terms of legal force and compliance?
items.answerSketch: They function only as non-binding guidelines, so compliance is voluntary with no enforcement mechanisms; the legal foundation is fragmented and a binding law or presidential regulation is still being drafted, and current rules don't explicitly regulate AI as a technology.

items.question: How should team leads and HR use AMANA's career grading framework differently, and how much room is there to deviate from the standard level criteria for specialised programs?
items.answerSketch: Leads use it for coaching, performance reviews and team capacity planning, working with HR on development plans; HR uses it for fairness and consistency in recruitment, placement, promotion, appraisals and succession planning. Because AMANA works through practice groups, reasonable deviations in tasks and criteria are allowed, and program-specific competencies complement rather than replace the grading structure — it is a baseline reference.

items.question: Dalam pengembangan SIKD generasi berikutnya untuk DJPK, apa saja kemampuan analitik yang disediakan sistem pendukung keputusan bagi pemantauan fiskal 542 pemerintah daerah?
items.answerSketch: DSS mengolah data fiskal tervalidasi menjadi analitik real-time: dashboard kualitas belanja, efektivitas TKD, pertumbuhan PAD, kondisi kas daerah, dan kepatuhan pelaporan, plus drill-down perbandingan antardaerah/tahun/jenis belanja serta laporan ringkas dan rekomendasi kebijakan bagi pimpinan.

items.question: Agenda kesehatan global apa saja yang dijadikan rujukan dalam penyusunan Rencana Induk Bidang Kesehatan, dan apa saja prioritas strategis yang ditetapkan WHO untuk periode 2025-2028?
items.answerSketch: Rujukan utamanya adalah SDGs 2030 (khususnya tujuan 3 tentang hidup sehat dan well-being, yang diinstitusionalisasikan lewat Perpres No. 111/2022) serta program kerja umum WHO ke-14 (GPW 14) 2025-2028 yang memuat empat agenda strategis, antara lain pencegahan dan mitigasi ancaman kesehatan masa depan termasuk perubahan iklim, penanganan determinan kesehatan, dan penguatan layanan kesehatan primer untuk mencapai UHC.

items.question: Which sectors are recommended for AI adoption support in Indonesia to spread digital transformation beyond big cities?
items.answerSketch: The report recommends extending digitalisation beyond urban centres and strategic sectors, with programmes supporting AI adoption in agriculture, MSMEs, public services, and sustainability for inclusive growth and productivity gains.

items.question: Mengapa pendekatan layanan kesehatan menurut tahapan usia dianggap solusi untuk kondisi Indonesia yang masih menanggung penyakit infeksi sekaligus penyakit kronis?
items.answerSketch: Indonesia menghadapi beban ganda penyakit (menular seperti TBC/malaria dan tidak menular seperti KJSU yang naik akibat gaya hidup, urbanisasi, demografi). Layanan berbasis siklus hidup menawarkan intervensi berkelanjutan dan terintegrasi dari kehamilan hingga lansia, menekankan pencegahan dan promosi sesuai kebutuhan usia sehingga deteksi dini lebih baik, kualitas hidup meningkat, dan beban ekonomi kesehatan nasional berkurang.

items.question: Siapa staf pengembangan bisnis senior di praktik digital yang punya sekitar enam tahun pengalaman dan bisa kami libatkan untuk menyiapkan proposal tender pemerintah?
items.answerSketch: Rita Damayanti, Senior Business Development Associate di practice group digital dengan 6 tahun pengalaman.

items.question: Who on our team has around 15 years of experience advising government on e-government and digital strategy, and can also lead data governance and analytics workstreams (SQL, data modeling, dashboards) for a public sector bid?
items.answerSketch: A senior consultant in the strategy and transformation practice with 15 years' experience, specializing in digital government/e-government, digital policy, and data governance, analytics, warehousing and visualization, plus public policy research and health system strengthening.

items.question: Siapa konsultan di praktik digital dengan pengalaman sekitar 10 tahun yang pernah memimpin penyusunan KPI, kerangka, dan perangkat pemantauan-evaluasi proyek, sekaligus terlibat dalam kelompok kerja dan perumusan kebijakan agenda pembangunan berkelanjutan di sektor infrastruktur, energi, air, dan sanitasi?
items.answerSketch: Seorang Senior Associate di practice group digital dengan 10 tahun pengalaman, ahli manajemen proyek, monitoring & evaluasi (memimpin Monev, membuat KPI dan tools/framework), serta kontribusi pada SDG di sektor infrastruktur, energi, air, dan sanitasi termasuk working group dan pembuatan kebijakan.

items.question: Siapa manajer proyek di praktik digital dengan sekitar 8 tahun pengalaman yang bisa memimpin riset pengguna mendalam sekaligus menyusun strategi digital dan peta jalan pengembangan produk, serta bersertifikasi human-centered design?
items.answerSketch: Aulia Chairunisa, Project Manager di practice group digital dengan 8 tahun pengalaman; keahlian utama digital strategy, product development, dan qualitative research; memiliki sertifikasi Design Kit (human-centered design) dan pelatihan riset pasar/product-market fit.

items.question: Siapa di tim kami yang menangani pengembangan kemitraan dan sudah punya pengalaman sekitar 12 tahun di ranah strategi dan transformasi organisasi?
items.answerSketch: Rekam talenta menunjukkan seorang staf dengan peran Partnership di practice group strategy & transformation dengan 12 tahun pengalaman.

items.question: Siapa konsultan senior di tim kesehatan dan pendidikan yang punya rekam jejak menulis makalah kebijakan ekonomi kesehatan di lembaga riset internasional, sekaligus kuat di analitik data dan penguatan sistem kesehatan?
items.answerSketch: Seorang Senior Associate di praktik health_education dengan 7 tahun pengalaman, menerbitkan 3 policy paper ekonomi kesehatan dalam 1,5 tahun di Center for Global Development, dengan kapabilitas epidemiologi, kebijakan kesehatan, penguatan sistem kesehatan, M&E, dan data analytics.

items.question: Is there an industry association for sharia-compliant financial technology providers in Indonesia that we could bring in as a digital economy partner?
items.answerSketch: Yes — the Indonesian Sharia Fintech Association (AFSI) is listed as a digital economy partner contact.

items.question: Which industry association represents peer-to-peer lending platforms in Indonesia and could be engaged as a partner on digital financing initiatives?
items.answerSketch: The record identifies AFPI (Asosiasi Fintech Pendanaan Bersama Indonesia), the association of Indonesian joint-funding fintech companies, under the digital economy financing cluster.

items.question: Apakah ada organisasi induk koperasi yang menaungi pedagang pasar tradisional dan terdaftar sebagai anggota luar biasa Kadin Indonesia yang bisa kami ajak sebagai mitra pelaksana?
items.answerSketch: Ya, INKOPPAS (Induk Koperasi Pedagang Pasar) tercatat sebagai Anggota Luar Biasa (ALB) Kadin Indonesia.

items.question: Is there an associate member association under Kadin Indonesia that represents companies supplying and supporting the oil and gas industry, who we could bring in as a consortium partner for an energy sector project?
items.answerSketch: Yes — an association of oil and gas supporting industries (INPEMIGAS) is listed as an ALB (associate) member of Kadin Indonesia, with a listed contact.

items.question: Have we ever built a vehicle tracking and route optimization platform for a large transport operator? Looking for a reference with fuel savings and on-time delivery numbers we can cite.
items.answerSketch: A 12-month engagement with a national logistics operator delivered GPS telematics tracking for 800 vehicles, a route optimization engine, driver mobile app and dispatch center, cutting fuel costs 18% in year one and raising on-time delivery to 94%.

items.question: Have we delivered a nationwide learning management system for a education ministry at multi-million student scale, including offline content sync and teacher change management? Looking for scale figures and rollout results to cite in a proposal.
items.answerSketch: A 20-month project for the Ministry of Education built a cloud-native LMS for 2 million students and 120,000 teachers, onboarding 1.8M active learners in year one, adoption across 34 provinces, and a 40% cut in content delivery cost versus CD distribution.

items.question: Apakah kita punya pengalaman implementasi sistem informasi rumah sakit skala provinsi yang terhubung ke platform data kesehatan nasional? Saya butuh referensi jumlah rumah sakit yang berhasil go-live dan dampaknya terhadap waktu proses klaim.
items.answerSketch: Proyek 22 bulan untuk Dinas Kesehatan Provinsi: penerapan HIS terintegrasi (EMR, farmasi, billing) di 120 rumah sakit dengan gateway integrasi SATUSEHAT/FHIR; 85 rumah sakit live dalam 18 bulan, waktu tunggu pasien turun 25%, pemrosesan klaim dari 14 hari menjadi 3 hari.

items.question: When we bid for city government digital transformation work, what do we usually lead with as our edge over other consultancies, and what objections do evaluation panels tend to raise?
items.answerSketch: Differentiators include embedded PMO delivery rather than advisory-only, the Surabaya command centre reference, AI/computer vision for traffic, cross-sector integration (health, transport, environment), and local government change management. Evaluators commonly question data quality assumptions, cross-agency coordination, and timeline realism.

items.question: Apa saja kriteria mutu wajib yang harus dipenuhi tiap bagian proposal AMANA (ringkasan eksekutif, pendekatan teknis, susunan tim, manajemen risiko) dan berapa skor minimal QC agar draf dianggap siap dikirim?
items.answerSketch: Ringkasan eksekutif wajib memuat 3 angka kunci dan outcome spesifik klien; pendekatan teknis merujuk minimal 2 proyek sejenis; susunan tim mencantumkan personel kunci bernama dengan pengalaman relevan; manajemen risiko minimal 5 risiko beserta mitigasi konkret; target skor QC 80+ untuk draf siap submit.

items.question: What does our work say about land certification and tenure security for informal settlements in Indonesian cities, and how have kampung upgrading or urban land consolidation schemes been financed by local governments?
items.whyUncovered: The corpus covers digital government, health, education, and public financial/strategy transformation work; it contains nothing on housing policy, land tenure, land certification, or slum/kampung upgrading programs.

items.question: What reserve price methodology and payment terms did Indonesia use for the 700 MHz and 26 GHz 5G spectrum auctions, and how were coverage obligations attached to the winning licences?
items.whyUncovered: The corpus covers digital government platforms, health and education systems, fiscal information systems, digital ID, and AI policy dialogue, but contains no material on telecommunications spectrum licensing, auction design, reserve pricing, or radio frequency allocation policy.

items.whyUncovered: Korpus berfokus pada transformasi digital, kesehatan digital, pendidikan, dan strategi kelembagaan; tidak ada materi mengenai infrastruktur air minum, sanitasi, atau pembiayaan SPAM/SPALD.
